name: 'Nduja pasta with cavolo nero
title: 'Nduja pasta

steps.text: Big pan of cold water, salt it well. Peel the potato, cut into 1 cm cubes, into the water and bring to the boil.
Pull the cavolo nero leaves off the stalks and tear them up.
Water boiling: potato has started its 10 minutes.
Pappardelle in (about 7 min); once it is boiling again add the cavolo nero.
Melt the butter in the big stir-fry pan, low-medium heat, stir in the 'nduja to make a sauce.
Scoop out a cup of pasta water; stir 3-4 tbsp into the 'nduja.
Drain pasta and greens, tip into the 'nduja pan, toss with more pasta water to make it glossy.
Pour over the olive oil, toss and serve straight away (bottle on the table).

equipment: a large stir-fry pan or wok
